repair.selection_rule:
per model, first-divergence classes among f01 differing states (all sub-banks, units cell x state) with >= 3 flips and
    flip-rate ratio vs the rest >= 1.5; if none qualifies, the 2 classes with most flips (flagged fallback). Plus a
    Q-defined span rule (no B needed): a_Q token positions whose Q margin is below the f01 per-model 10th percentile of
    per-token Q margins over U1 a_Q tokens.

rule.population: U1 (Q's own-trajectory states); escalate iff score > per-cell threshold

candidates.S_H0: entropy (top-20 + tail bucket) of Q's next-token distribution at the action start
candidates.S_mm: -(min over a_Q tokens of Q's margin lp(chosen) - max lp(other top-20))
candidates.S_lp: -(mean over a_Q tokens of Q's logprob)

rule.selection_criterion: max mean over rates {5,10,20}% of (in-sample f01 U1 net gain - random expectation); tie: turnover captured - random expectation
rule.primary_endpoint: validation-block U1 pooled net gain sum(Y_BQ - Y_QQ) over escalated states vs a random trigger escalating the same number of states per cell (exact one-sided p), at each rate
rule.secondary: rescued, damaged, turnover captured; U2B/U2Q and the non-chosen candidates are reported as secondary
